description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bogahwaththa, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511009 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title determinations.
